Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever…

translations.web: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?
translations.bsb: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the One who is able to save and destroy. But who are you to judge your neighbor?
translations.kjv: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?
translations.asv: One only is the lawgiver and judge, even he who is able to save and to destroy: but who art thou that judgest thy neighbor?
